itemized.notes: Sim Gill, District Attorney, 2006 interim report - the form checks OCTOBER 31 'for the period ending October 30, 2006' (signed 10/31/06, clerk stamp OCT 31 2006). Schedule B is the HANDWRITTEN county form on PDF pages 4-6 (the filer's own 'Page 1/2/3 of 5') and is fully transcribed; Schedule A is a typed LANDSCAPE spreadsheet on PDF pages 7-15 and is WITHHELD (see withheld_reason - a capacity limit, not a legibility one). Schedule B properties: cents are written as a raised group over a rule throughout and are transcribed with a decimal point; TWO amounts are printed with NO cents group at all ('11,400' on p4 and '20,005' on p5) and are kept verbatim; EIGHT rows are marked IN KIND by the filer writing 'In kind' inside the Name-of-Recipient cell itself rather than in a separate column (they DO count toward the printed totals); two of those rows carry corrections written above the line ('schaefer' over a struck surname with 'Photographer' over 'Self Employed'; 'Anchor Printing' written above 'Tanya Henrie'). The recipient 'SL Co. Demo Party' (the Salt Lake County Democratic Party) appears nine times with the filer's spelling varying line to line - each is kept as written. BALANCE-SUMMARY FINDING (re-read at 200 and 300 dpi): line 3 30,099.14 + line 4 65,294.94 = line 5 95,394.08 closes exactly, and line 5 - line 6 = line 7 also closes exactly - but only because LINE 6 IS WRITTEN 74,445.04 while LINE 2 (Total Expenditures Made, Column A) is written 74,445.01. Schedule B's own printed TOTAL is 74,445.01 and the 30 transcribed rows sum to exactly 74,445.01, so line 2 is the correct figure and line 6 carries a 3-cent slip; 95,394.08 - 74,445.04 = 20,949.04 = the printed line 7. Both figures are retained verbatim and nothing was recomputed. || RESIDUE PASS 2026-08-03: the withheld Schedule A is now TRANSCRIBED - 354 rows, p7-p15. The predecessor's withheld_reason said the only available gate was the Summary Page figure; that was WRONG - the attachment prints its own grand total on p15 and the rows close on it exactly, which is what localises the 3 cents to filer arithmetic. Its earlier ~387-row estimate (from counting text runs) also overcounted: the true grid is 41 rows/page x8 + 26.
